title: The contractible scalar realization adjunction
statement: Let J be an essentially small site with C in Type(u+1), Hom in Type u, and let O be a commutative abelian-sheaf ring object. Let U be terminal. Use the actual functors F and G of [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model] and assume the small sectionwise derived category exists. If terminal evaluation has the exact cocontinuous, representative-normalized derived tensor data [lem-zl-contractible-derived-sections-tensor], then there is an adjunction F left adjoint to G with invertible unit; F is strong symmetric monoidal for the ordinary Koszul braidings and G is strong monoidal.

proof.text: Choose the ordinary model and its universal left-derived comparison. Apply the proved generic derivedAdjunction construction and transport its left adjoint along L.leftDerivedFunctor ≅ F.

Apply the ordinary-unit lemma. Its induced homotopy adjunction has invertible unit by localizing the ordinary composite-is-identity comparison. Exact sections have invertible right-derived comparison everywhere. On K-flat representatives the derived unit equation identifies the derived unit, followed by the image of the left-derived counit, with the localized ordinary unit followed by that right-derived comparison. All three other maps are invertible, so cancellation proves the unit invertible. Every derived object has such a representative. Transport to the fixed F adjunction.

The ordinary model is braided, flat preserving and a left adjoint. Apply the proved generic leftDerivedFunctorBraided construction for native Koszul braidings, and transport its monoidal structure along L.leftDerivedFunctor ≅ F. The comparison is monoidal for the transported structure, so LaxBraided.ofNatIso supplies the braided axiom on precisely F.

Transport exactness of evaluation through the ordinary section-module equivalence. Apply the normalized tensor-transport statement to the exact termwise derived sections functor. The canonical rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory identifies it with G, and Functor.Monoidal.transport gives the required monoidal structure on G.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction to the ordinary unit, ordinary realization model, and normalized tensor transport. The derived-unit cancellation and braided left derivation are proved.
